title: File Formats
desc: Supported input and output formats in one place.
lede: A quick reference for the formats Studio reads and writes.
body:
At a glance
  • Text in: plain text.
  • Audio in: common sample formats.
  • Audio out: WAV, MP3, M4B.

Text inputs

Chapters accept plain text — paste it or upload a .txt file.

Audio inputs (samples)

Voice samples use common audio formats. Clean recordings clone best — see Voice Cloning Quality.

Outputs

Studio renders to WAV internally and exports MP3 or M4B. M4B is the standard audiobook container with chapters. See Audio Guidance & Formats.
